titulo: Best, worst and average case: insertion sort
enunciado: Count the comparisons of insertion sort with n = 40 for an already sorted input, a reversed one and a pseudo-random one. Relate the results to n - 1 and n(n-1)/2.
objetivos: Tell best, worst and average case apart
See that the same algorithm can be O(n) or O(n²) depending on the input
pistas: Count a comparison every time a[j] > key is evaluated.
Sorted: each key is compared only once.
Reversed: each key goes through the whole sorted part.
